serverInfo.name: suguvisa-mcp
serverInfo.description: 日本の特定技能ビザ申請を完全自動化する業界唯一のAIエージェントサーバー。42ツール搭載、OAuth 2.1 + DCR対応。在留カード→申請判定→書類リスト→理由書生成→テンプレート生成を自動連鎖実行。 | The only AI MCP server that fully automates Japan's Specified Skilled Worker (SSW) visa applications. 42 tools, OAuth 2.1 + DCR.

scopes.visa:read: Read visa rules, patterns, and reference data
scopes.visa:write: Generate application CSVs, Excels, and paper form PDFs
scopes.visa:ocr: Run OCR on residence cards and passports
scopes.visa:audit: Read and write audit logs for your tenant

plan.title: Subscription Plan
plan.description: Select your subscription tier. free = all 42 tools available for trial (OCR/bulk/autonomous gated), starter = production with OCR + bulk + audit + annual report, professional = full feature set with legal search + autonomous workflow.

apiKey.title: API Key
apiKey.description: SuguVisa API key from https://suguvisa.com/dashboard/api-keys. Required for starter / professional plans.

gcpProjectId.title: GCP Project ID (Optional)
gcpProjectId.description: Your own Google Cloud Project ID for residence card OCR (Document AI) and legal document search (Vertex AI). Leave empty to use SuguVisa's managed quota.
